title: Karaoke
description: Synced lyrics in the Apple Music style over a slow mesh of the cover's colours. The active line fills word by word, held notes swell and glow letter by letter, and every line rides its own spring so the column settles in a cascade. Far lines soften by weight and focus rather than fading. Scroll or drag to look around, click a line to jump there.
intent: Lyrics as the instrument: a word-by-word fill and a staggered spring scroll, with hierarchy carried by weight and blur.
